column4: PR #2663: the package's other files (harness.go, health_identity.go's siblings) carry `//go:build e2e` and only run in tagged e2e jobs, but health_identity.go deliberately has no build tag (its own doc comment explains why: pure decision logic the author wants exercised by the default `go test ./...` on every PR, which is how #2596's pre-nonce-release regression reached main unnoticed) — that untagged file is what first makes `go list ./...` see this directory at all. Every file in the package is e2e test-support code (none of it is imported by the production server/cli binaries).
